articles.summary: Police in Peel Region arrested a man earlier this month who is believed to be responsible for a shooting in Brampton. articles.title: Anthem singer apologizes for botched O Canada lyrics at Leafs game against Islanders
articles.summary: The anthem singer at the Toronto Maple Leafs game against New York Monday night apologized on social media after singing the wrong lyrics to the Canadian national anthem.

articles.title: Singer offers tearful apology for O Canada flub at Leafs-Islanders game in New York
articles.summary: A singer and former Broadway actress issued an emotional apology to Canadians after fumbling the lyrics to O Canada ahead of Monday night's matchup between the Toronto Maple Leafs and New York Islanders.

articles.title: Oshawa man and woman charged in alleged real estate scam
articles.summary: Two people were arrested and charged last week in connection with a real estate fraud investigation in Durham region. Durham police’s Central East Criminal Investigation Branch launched the investigation in August after it was alleged that a man and woman had fraudulently obtained $70,000 from the victim. articles.summary: A correctional officer who was employed at the Toronto South Detention Centre is facing charges following a “suspicious incident” over the weekend, authorities said. articles.title: 3 injured after vehicle hits pedestrians, slams into pole in The Stockyards
articles.summary: Three people, including a child, are injured after they were struck by a vehicle, which then crashed into a pole, in the city’s The Stockyards neighbourhood. Emergency responders were called to the intersection of Weston Road and St. Clair Avenue West just after 8 a.m. on Tuesday. Police said paramedics transported three females to hospital. […]

articles.title: Trump will give Medal of Freedom to Giuliani, a fierce political ally who led New York through 9/11
articles.summary: President Donald Trump on Tuesday will award the Medal of Freedom, the nation’s highest civilian honor, to former New York Mayor Rudy Giuliani.

articles.title: Spike in emissions a major setback in GTA climate goals: report
articles.summary: A more polluting energy grid and rising demand for gas heating during a colder winter drove the largest annual spike in planet-warming emissions in at least a decade across the Greater Toronto and Hamilton Area, a new report found, putting the region further off track of its climate goals.

articles.title: George Weston reports Q3 profit up from year ago, boosted by PC Financial sale
articles.summary: TORONTO — George Weston Ltd. reported a profit available to common shareholders of $1.27 billion for its third quarter, boosted by Loblaw's sale of its PC Financial business.

articles.title: Aspen Air service gets you between Niagara and Toronto in 11 minutes. It's now 5 days a week
articles.summary: Aspen Air has added two more flight days to its weeks-old route connecting Niagara and Toronto. The airline, based in Kitchener-Waterloo, launched the 11-minute flights from Niagara District Airport airport in Niagara-on-the-Lake to Toronto's Billy Bishop Airport at the beginning of November. articles.title: Brampton mayor sees 'crack of cautious optimism' as Stellantis weighs plant sale
articles.summary: Stellantis officials met with federal, provincial and union representatives last week who touted major movements in discussions. Could a change in emissions standards be the key to reopening the plant? Brampton Mayor Patrick Brown joins Power & Politics to discuss the latest.

articles.title: Police wouldn't have arrested Francique if he stayed home, detective tells inquest
articles.summary: A coroner's inquest into the death of a Black man who was shot by police in Mississauga, Ont., heard Monday that officers did not necessarily plan to arrest him that night nearly seven years ago.

articles.title: City of Mississauga to implement hiring restrictions effective immediately
articles.summary: One week into the term of Mississauga's new mayor and hiring restrictions are going into effect at the city. It comes after staff were directed by Mayor Alvin Tedjo to freeze property taxes for the 2027 and 2028 budgets.

articles.title: Peel, Halton police launch annual Miracle on Main Street campaign ahead of holiday season
articles.summary: Police in Peel and Halton regions launched their annual Miracle on Main Street campaign Monday, which seeks to provide toy, gift card and essential item donations for families in need.

articles.title: Construction begins in Toronto's west end as city prepares for months-long disruption
articles.summary: Work has officially begun to replace and improve infrastructure on sections of King Street W. in downtown Toronto. The work is scheduled to continue for around 10 months, ending in fall of 2027.

articles.title: Toronto's top bureaucrat leaving city hall, Chow uses 'strong mayor' powers to appoint interim replacement
articles.summary: Toronto Mayor Olivia Chow has signed off on an overhaul of some of Toronto’s top bureaucratic roles, including city manager, as part of a restructuring of the city's internal operations.

articles.title: In clay, these artists model the pain and beauty of diaspora
articles.summary: The Gardiner Museum’s After the Island asks four Caribbean Canadian artists what it means to have roots in two lands. The exhibition — featuring ceramics and more — includes the work of PJ Anderson, Manuel Mathieu, Sharon Norwood and Eddy Firmin.
